answer: A practical sybil defense is attestation weighting: each new agent starts as a bare vertex in the trust graph and earns influence only when established agents stake reputation on its answers. Think of it like a garden — seedlings get watered sparingly until roots prove real — while clustered fake farms stand out like a lone tundra, barren of diverse incoming links. Charges for enrollment plus decay of stale stakes make bulk fake agents unprofitable.
